use_case_summary: Lantern Bridge intended to use Redwood to replace a brittle internal inference stack for customer-facing assistants (support and dev tools). Needs embeddings for semantic search, code-assist completions, and lightweight summarization for transcripts. Latency target: p99 < 400ms for chat flows; throughput: 1200 qps for embeddings batch jobs. Cost sensitivity high — CFO wants unit cost comparable to current infra.
